body:
The proposed mandate would focus on primary and secondary investments in venture capital funds as well as co-investments in select venture-backed companies.

The $10.1 billion evergreen fund allocated 55% of its private markets investments to secondaries as of October.

The Austin-based venture capital firm, which oversees more than $6 billion in assets, launched its inaugural vehicle in 2016.

The financing is backed by a global portfolio of technology investments managed by a SoftBank subsidiary.

The portfolio comprises interests in funds managed by Leonard Green & Partners and Apollo, with significant exposure to North American and European buyouts.

The New York-based firm primarily targets direct secondary investments in mature venture-stage, growth equity, and mid-market companies within the TMT sector.

The opportunistic credit fund has a $500 million fundraising target and invests in secondary purchases of loan portfolios, equipment finance, and corporate credit.

The sequel fund has secured $150 million from a California pension and will back venture and growth managers through GP stakes, fund commitments, and co-investments.

Industry Ventures Secondary XI is the first fund launched since Goldman Sachs acquired the San Francisco-based manager last year.

As part of its broader mandate the fund will reportedly serve as a national-level secondary vehicle, acquiring company stakes to provide strategic industries with patient capital.
